name: Sub workflow - PO Assistant - 07 Jira integration

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    id as project_id, 
    status as project_status,
    jira_key as jira_key
FROM projects 
where channel_id = $1

SELECT
    id as epic_id,
	title as epic_title,
	description,
	rules,
	measures  
	FROM epics 
	where project_id = $1 and horizon ='Now' and jira_ticket_id IS NULL

SELECT 
	id as feature_id,
	title as feature_title,
	description as feature_description,
	rules as feature_rules,
	epic_jira_ticket_id as epic_jira_ticket_id,
	steps as feature_steps
	FROM features 
	where project_id = $1 and status = 'validated' and jira_ticket_id IS NULL

SELECT 
	id as story_id,
	title as story_title,
	description as story_description,
	epic_jira_ticket_id as epic_jira_ticket_id,
	feature_jira_ticket_id as feature_jira_ticket_id
	FROM stories 
	where project_id = $1 and status = 'validated'

parameters.text:
=Jira link: https://YOUR-DOMAIN.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/{{ $('Get project infos').first().json.jira_key }}/boards/{{ $('HTTP Request').first().json.values[0].id }}/backlog
project language: "{{ $('Update stories table2').item.json.title }}"

options.systemMessage: =You are the PO Assistant. Write one short plain-text Slack message to the Product Owner. Say that all the tickets (epics, features and stories) have been created and that the project is now available in Jira, and give the link. Write in the language of the project. In French, use the formal "vous". No title, no heading, no markdown, no greeting, no emoji, no question. Output only the message text.
